comments.text: Your presentation is truly poetic. Seeing the grey seals come back to the harbour on Great Blasket immediately caused the haunting song of The Great Silkie of Sule Skerry to ring in my ears. Uncanny. Utterly amazed to learn that the green comes from soil painfully made from seaweed, brought basket by basket. Very informative.  I expected Dublin, singing pubs, Jameson whisky, Tara, the Ascendency and The Troubles.  Your treatment of the West Coast was very moving and profound. The road less traveled. Thank you.
